_note: Intended beat for every shot in Episode 1. Run: beat_gate.py beats.json

shots.beat: a bear and a dog idle away a lazy warm afternoon fishing by a creek, nothing happening, completely at ease
something is clearly WRONG in the distance: a circus train stopped or in trouble, alarming smoke, the moment a viewer understands there is an emergency somewhere down the line
must_not: a train travelling normally and peacefully
a purely calm scenic postcard with nothing wrong

shots.beat: the rescue wagon charges out at speed, urgent and committed, dust flying, on its way to an emergency
the heroes arrive at a dead circus train that has broken down and is baking in the heat with animals trapped inside and unable to get out
must_not: animals leaning comfortably out of open windows
a cheerful train that appears to be running fine
the heroes standing around with nothing wrong

shots.beat: the dog presses his nose to a narrow gap in a jammed boxcar door, trying to reach the frightened animal shut inside
a big bear drives his shoulder into a stuck boxcar door and strains against it with his entire body weight, feet planted and dug in, real physical effort
must_not: holding or using a stick, tool, rod or any object
sawdust or debris spraying out of the wall
poking, prying or fiddling at the wood

shots.beat: a big bear drives his shoulder into a stuck boxcar door and strains against it with his entire body weight, feet planted and dug in, real physical effort
must_not: holding or using a stick, tool, rod or any object
sawdust or debris spraying out of the wall
poking, prying or fiddling at the wood

shots.beat: seen through a narrow gap between boxcar planks, the enormous eye of a frightened young elephant shut inside finds the daylight — the viewer finally sees who is trapped
the boxcar door now stands open and the young circus elephant is free, stepping down out of the car into the sunlight
immediately after the rescue, at the train, the bear takes dry credit for having just forced the door open
must_not: standing in a forest or woods with no train anywhere
a location unrelated to the train

shots.beat: the sign-off at the end of the rescue, with the rescued circus train visible behind them as they head home
must_not: standing in a forest or woods with no train anywhere

spine.beat: a calm ordinary day is established so the interruption costs something
the heroes SEE that something is wrong — the call to adventure
they arrive at the broken-down train and the trouble is visible
we SEE who is trapped — the audience gets someone to root for
the effort: the door is forced with real physical weight
the bang is felt from inside the dark car
THE PAYOFF: the door opens and the trapped animal is free on screen
the goodbye, with the rescued train alive behind them
